newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes firmer as Gulf tensions ease.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes firmer as Gulf tensions ease.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly firmer at T$27.492 on Thursday compared to its previous close of T$27.494 after tensions in the Gulf eased, and dealers expected the rate to move narrowly in the near term.

"Since overseas markets did not react to the Gulf news today, some exporters started to sell U.S. dollars," said one dealer. Other dealers saw selling pressure on the greenback on possible inflow of foreign equity, which have been expected to enter the domestic stock market.
Turnover was US$229 million. A T$27.46-52 trading range was seen. - Joyce Liu (5080815)
